user.title: Modbus gateway
user.description: Address of the Modbus-to-Ethernet gateway the meters are connected to. The gateway must be in RTU-over-TCP mode.

meter.title: Add a meter
meter.description: Enter the Modbus slave address of a meter on the bus and the name it should appear under in Home Assistant. The model is detected automatically.

error.no_meter: No meter answered at this slave address. Check the address and the wiring.
error.unknown_model: A device answered but is not a supported Eastron SDM meter.
error.duplicate_slave: This slave address is already configured.

add_meter.title: Add a meter
add_meter.description: Enter the Modbus slave address of a meter on the bus and the name it should appear under in Home Assistant. The model is detected automatically.

remove_meter.title: Remove a meter
remove_meter.description: Select the meters to remove. Their devices, entities and history are deleted; the other meters on this gateway keep working.

error.no_meter: No meter answered at this slave address. Check the address and the wiring.
error.unknown_model: A device answered but is not a supported Eastron SDM meter.
error.duplicate_slave: This slave address is already configured.
error.last_meter: This is the last meter on this gateway. Delete the integration entry instead of removing it.

abort.last_meter: This is the last meter on this gateway. Delete the integration entry instead of removing it.
